title: Your LLM Lites, so why trust it?
author: Nvestiq
selftext: Lots of platforms are built on LLMs, and it gets annoying. Wrong metrics, random figures, and just overall false hope. The truth is, it comes down to the infrastructure, and that's where we excel. What you intend is what you see. Trade with confidence and see for yourself. We're wrapping up a community beta this month, and would love everyone to join us for our official release soon. Nothing is needed except an email so we can notify you when your spot in line comes.
